languageReview.method: Reuse event names or existing traditional-Mongolian spellings; verify core facts in English and Cyrillic Mongolian, then write short traditional-Mongolian drafts.

limits: Event links distinguish direct actors from contextual rulers/deceased people where the existing event mentions them.
No grandparent-to-parent edge is inferred between Dayan and Altan; no undocumented political alliance is added.
Birth/death and reign disagreements are preserved in the per-person rows. Full traditional-Mongolian sentence proofreading remains separate.
